prompt: help me plan my weekend trip to yosemite
response: Your weekend trip to Yosemite sounds fantastic! Start by visiting the Yosemite Valley, where you can hike along the Merced River and see the iconic Half Dome. Don't miss the chance to see the Valley's waterfalls, like Bridalveil Fall. You can also explore the Mariposa Grove of Giant Sequoias. Make sure to check the park's website for any updates on opening times and restrictions.
